scripts.build:web: npm run typegen && tsc -p tsconfig.app.json && tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json && vite build
scripts.test:core: npm run build:core && node scripts/core-smoke.mjs && node scripts/product-bot-smoke.mjs
scripts.test:worker: npm run typegen && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts --max-workers=1 --no-isolate
scripts.check: npm run test:core && npm run test:worker && npm run build:web
